mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative SPX 60d returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 indicates economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP growth consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as stronger economic growth supports corporate profits and valuations.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive in more than 50% of quarters but SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of those quarters.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation above 3.0% year-over-year signals central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls and rising unemployment signal labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: The joint decline of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not lead to negative SPX 5d returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturns (HOUST < 1200 thousand units) signal reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1200.
